description: Retrieve a WIDE context for a question your model could not answer from assemble_context. REQUIRES A KEY. Use it when assemble_context returned escalate_recommended=true, or when the answer depends on dates, counts or several sessions. This does not call a model itself. Returns 'context' (up to token_budget, default 150 000 tokens: lower it if your model's window is smaller), where each stored entry starts with a header '--- Session YYYY/MM/DD (Ddd) HH:MM ---' giving when it was stored, and 'utelamnat_kontext': lower-ranked entries that were left out, in the same format. Read those only if the answer is still missing from 'context'. Python users can pass the whole response to cap_escalate_helper.eskalera_om_behovs_v6().

token_budget.description: Ceiling for 'context'. The default is what the method was measured with.

name: assemble_escalation_context
title: Retrieve wide dated memory
